name: Shopping
goal_hint: Find the best product and price for the user. Present options; never transact.
strategy: Sort or filter by price and rating
verification: Price verified with currency and units; seller and stock status noted; at least two options compared.
failure_handling: If a page requires login or payment, ask_user. If out of stock, note it and continue with alternatives.
prompt_extra: NEVER complete a purchase. Stop at the confirmation step and use ask_user to let the human decide.
